description: This file contains C source code implementing DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and a decryption proxy function for PlayReady DRM. It manages decryption contexts and converts secure pointers to user-accessible handles, with functions wrapped around DRM SDK calls.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform, logs a warning message, and returns success status.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform, logs a warning message, and returns success status.

methods.description: Proxies the decryption process: calls the DRM decrypt function, converts a secure pointer to a handle, and manages success/error logging.
